lessons.name: Sudden Confusion
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: But one Tuesday morning, the energy in the gym was replaced with confusion. The PE teacher, Coach Harris, had discovered that several pieces of equipment were missing.

lessons.name: Missing Equipment
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: A volleyball net, a bag of soccer balls, and two sets of badminton rackets had vanished overnight. Students gathered near the gym doors, whispering about the theft as Coach Harris made his way to the office to report it.

lessons.name: Maria Investigates
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: In the crowd, Maria, a junior who spent most of her free time playing volleyball, felt a surge of curiosity. The equipment wasn't just school property - it was essential for her team's practices. Beside her stood her best friend, Ethan, who shared her knack for solving puzzles.

lessons.name: Storage Room
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: By lunch, the school was buzzing with rumors. Maria and Ethan weren't satisfied with wild guesses. They decided to investigate. Their first stop was the equipment room. The small storage area behind the gym was usually locked, but Coach Harris had left it open while inspecting what was left.

lessons.name: Dust Trail
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: Maria and Ethan slipped inside, their eyes scanning the labeled shelves. It didn't take long to spot something unusual. One of the shelves, which usually held volleyballs, had been wiped clean of dust, as though something large had been dragged across it. Ethan pointed to faint scuff marks on the floor.

lessons.name: Clue Found
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: They followed the marks to the door, which was slightly ajar. Outside, the afternoon sunlight revealed a faint trail of shoe prints leading across the grass toward the parking lot. Maria and Ethan hurried to the lot, weaving between rows of cars. Then, they found something that confirmed their suspicions.

lessons.name: Dropped Shuttlecock
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: It was a stray shuttlecock from the missing badminton set. It lay half-crushed in the dirt, as if it had been dropped in haste. Ethan crouched down to examine the ground around it. The shoe prints seemed to match the kind of sneakers most students wore during PE class. Whoever had taken the equipment hadn't gone far.

lessons.name: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment (Part 1)
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment

lessons.name: Shoe Prints
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: The trail led them toward the edge of the school grounds, where an old shed stood just beyond the baseball field.

lessons.name: Old Shed
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: Ethan got closer and peered through the gap of the shed door. He caught sight of something familiar - the volleyball net, tangled and stuffed into the corner.

lessons.name: Equipment Located
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: They opened the shed door and walked inside. The bag of soccer balls sat near the door, its zipper partially undone, and the badminton rackets propped against the wall.

lessons.name: Unexpected Visitor
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: There was no sign of whoever had taken them. Then, the sound of footsteps outside froze the two. They raced behind a stack of crates as a figure stepped inside. It was Alex Harper, a senior known for his competitive streak.

lessons.name: Stolen Practice
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: Maria and Ethan watched Alex. He must have taken the equipment to practice on his own. He was always pushing himself to be the best, but stealing from the school was a step too far.

lessons.name: Crate Noise
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: As Alex rummaged, Ethan accidentally shifted, causing one of the crates to scrape against the floor. Alex spun around, his eyes widening as he spotted them. For a moment, no one moved.

lessons.name: A Confrontation
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: Mia stepped forward, holding up the list she had found. She pointed to the pile of equipment, silently demanding an explanation. Alex's shoulders slumped, and he raised his hands as if surrendering.

lessons.name: Truth Revealed
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: Without a word, Alex began gathering the equipment, placing it neatly back into the bags and cases. Mia and Ethan helped, their frustration softening as they realized Alex had just let his competitive nature get the best of him.

lessons.name: Mystery Solved
lessons.stage: The Case of the Stolen PE Equipment
lessons.text1: The three of them returned to the gym, and soon the stolen equipment was back in place. Alex promised to explain everything to Coach Harris, and Maria and Ethan decided to leave it at that. They felt good that they had solved the case and that the equipment was now safe.

lessons.name: First Snowfall
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: The first snowfall of the season transformed the usually green fields of Flower View High.

instruction.body: Boost your typing skills while solving a fun mystery. Gather clues and become a typing master! Welcome to "The Disappearing Footsteps"!

lessons.name: Winter Magic
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Students trudged across the snow-covered sidewalks in their boots. It was the kind of scene that made winter mornings feel magical.

lessons.name: Strange Footprints
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Amid this picturesque morning, Anna noticed a trail of footprints leading away from the sidewalk as she walked toward the school's entrance.

lessons.name: Trail Ends
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Something felt off about these prints. The footprints stopped abruptly, right at the tree line, as if the person who made them had vanished.

lessons.name: Growing Curiosity
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Anna squinted at the ground, the rest of the snow untouched. Curiosity sparked in her mind. She wasn't the type to ignore something unusual, so she vowed to return to this spot later in the day.

lessons.name: Mystery Partners
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Her friend, Jake, loved mysteries and immediately wanted to investigate with Anna once she told him what she saw. The two friends decided to try following the footprints that afternoon. They couldn't just disappear, right?

lessons.name: Afternoon Search
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: As the final bell rang, they grabbed their backpacks and made their way to the spot where Anna had seen the disappearing footprints. The day's sunlight was fading, casting long shadows across the snow. The footprints were still there, curving away from the sidewalk and stopping abruptly at the edge of the woods.

lessons.name: Vanishing Trail
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Jake carefully knelt down to examine them. He then looked ahead into the woods where the prints seemed to simply vanish. Even though he loved mysteries, Jake felt a bit scared. His mind went to a more supernatural explanation. He wasn't sure now if he wanted to find out why the footprints disappeared so eerily.

lessons.name: The Disappearing Footsteps (Part 1)
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Detective Log Entry 304: Investigating The Disappearing Footsteps - The Disappearing Footsteps (Part 1). Carefully analyze every clue and examine the evidence to solve the mystery.

lessons.name: New Clues
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Anna insisted that they find out why the footprints disappear. Just then, she noticed a large tree stump and a giant rock nearby.

lessons.name: Climbing Clue
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: As she stepped closer to the tree stump and rock, she saw a left footprint on the stump and a right foot print on the rock. Of course! The footprints didn't simply disappear. Their owner had stepped up onto the stump then had jumped to the rock.

lessons.name: Tracks Continue
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Once the friends noticed these prints, they knew they wanted to see where else this mystery person had stepped. As they walked around the stump and rock, they saw the footprints pick up again in the snow.

lessons.name: Red Fabric
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Just then, Jake spotted something unusual on a low-hanging branch - a small piece of red fabric, frozen and stiff. It looked like part of a scarf, frayed at the edges as if it had been caught on the branch.

lessons.name: Snow Clearing
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Then, they saw a small clearing in the woods. It was odd, though. The snow in the center had been disturbed, as though someone had been standing there for a long time. They also saw a square dent in the snow, as if someone had sat on a blanket there.

lessons.name: Pencil Shavings
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: They continued following the prints. Anna pointed to some pencil shavings she found on the snow, like someone had been sharpening pencils outside. "How strange," she thought. She became even more curious about the area. The friends walked further and then spotted an unpaved back road ahead.

lessons.name: Wooden Bridge
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Along the road, the footprints stopped near a small wooden bridge. Next to the bridge, Anna and Jake spotted a wool blanket and a backpack. They also saw an open notebook, pencil, pack of crackers, and a pair of gloves placed carefully on top of the snow near the backpack.

lessons.name: Animal Sketches
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: As they got closer, the two saw that the notebook page was filled with sketches of animals - deer, birds, and even a fox. Anna saw that the open pages had drawings that were dated from the current week. It became clear that someone had been there recently, quietly sketching the wildlife, trying to leave minimal footprints in the snow.

lessons.name: Mystery Solved
lessons.stage: The Disappearing Footsteps
lessons.text1: Anna and Jake decided to leave the items there and go home. They felt satisfied knowing that the footprints they saw belonged to someone who was documenting nature through artwork, and the two friends were glad they finally understood where the footprints led. They carefully walked back through the woods toward their school again, reflecting on the beautiful drawings they had just seen.

lessons.name: Busy Lab
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: The library computer lab at Hillside Middle School was always buzzing during lunch.

instruction.body: Boost your typing skills while solving a fun mystery. Gather clues and become a typing master! Welcome to "The Forgotten Password"!

lessons.name: Lunchtime Rush
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Students rushed in to finish homework, check their email, or play the latest math games their teachers recommended.

lessons.name: Frozen Screen
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Sophie sat in front of one of the computers, staring at the login screen. Her hands hovered over the keyboard, her heart pounding.

lessons.name: Forgotten Password
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Sophie needed to access her student account to print her science report. It was her most important assignment of the semester. But there was a problem: she had forgotten her password.

lessons.name: Panic Rising
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: She had been sure she'd remember it, confident she wouldn't need to write it down. Now, as the clock ticked closer to the end of lunch, her confidence had vanished. Just then, her friend Kamani walked into the lab.

lessons.name: Calling Kamani
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: She waved Kamani over and pointed to her screen, explaining the situation through frantic gestures. Kamani nodded, her expression shifting into problem-solving mode. She told Sophie to think back to when she created the password.

lessons.name: Memory Search
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: What was she thinking about at the time? Sophie closed her eyes, trying to recall the day. It had been a month ago, during a particularly busy week. She remembered choosing something simple - something she wouldn't forget. But what? Kamani began jotting down possible clues.

lessons.name: Password Guesses
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Did it involve her favorite color? Her pet's name? A memorable number? Sophie nodded slowly. It might have included her cat's name, Luna, or maybe the number of books she had read that year. Kamani wrote "Luna" and several variations of it, adding random numbers at the end: "Luna123," "Luna321," and even "LunaCat."

lessons.name: The Forgotten Password (Part 1)
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Detective Log Entry 325: Investigating The Forgotten Password - The Forgotten Password (Part 1). Carefully analyze every clue and examine the evidence to solve the mystery.

lessons.name: Sort the Events
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Detective Log Entry 326: Investigating The Forgotten Password - Sort the Events. Carefully analyze every clue and examine the evidence to solve the mystery.

lessons.name: Failed Attempts
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Sophie typed in each guess carefully, her hands growing more frantic with every rejection.

lessons.name: Clue Hunt
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: The computer screen blinked with the same frustrating message: Incorrect Password. Try Again. Kamani leaned back in her chair, tapping her pen against the notebook.

lessons.name: Old Passwords
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: They needed more clues. Sophie gestured toward her backpack, and Kamani grabbed it, rifling through her folders and notebooks for any hint. She found a list titled "Passwords" scribbled on the back of a math worksheet.

lessons.name: The Attempts
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Sophie knew these passwords were old ones, but it gave them a starting point. Many of the old passwords included numbers that meant something to Sophie - her birthday, the year her cat was born, or her locker combination.

lessons.name: Lunch Countdown
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1:
She started combining these with newer ideas, trying to create a pattern that might unlock her account.
"Luna012"? No.
"LibraryCat14"? No.
"ScienceFair22"? Still no.
Lunch was nearly over, and Sophie's panic was rising.

lessons.name: New Strategy
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Kamani snapped her fingers, pulling Sophie's attention back to the notebook. She pointed to a line she had circled earlier: "Combine favorites." She scribbled down a new idea - what if Sophie had combined her favorite things into one password? Something unique but meaningful to her?

lessons.name: Memory Spark
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: Sophie frowned, thinking hard. She loved Luna, of course, but she also loved her favorite book series. Her mind flashed to a memory of staying up late to reread her favorite, The Secret Tunnel Adventure. She had even written an essay about it for class earlier that week. Could she have included that in her password?

lessons.name: Login Success
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: With trembling hands, Sophie typed "SecretLuna13" into the login screen. The screen froze for a moment, and her heart sank. Then, the screen blinked, and the desktop appeared. She was in! Sophie nearly jumped out of her chair, relief washing over her like a wave. Kamani gave her a thumbs-up, and she quickly found her files.

lessons.name: Printed Victory
lessons.stage: The Forgotten Password
lessons.text1: The sound of the printer whirring to life was the sweetest sound she had heard all day. As the final lunch bell rang, Sophie grabbed her freshly printed report and stuffed it into her folder. She couldn't stop smiling, the earlier panic already fading into a distant memory. Kamani followed her out of the library, their triumphant expressions matching.

lessons.name: Ordinary Afternoon
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: It started on an ordinary Friday afternoon, as the sun began its slow descent over Oakridge Middle School.

lessons.name: Lingering Shadows
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Most of the students had gone home, but Jade and Noah lingered near the edge of the field, where the trees cast long, shifting shadows on the grass.

lessons.name: Sunlight Experiment
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Jade was sketching in her notebook, and Noah was experimenting with a small magnifying glass, catching the sunlight and watching it move across the ground.

lessons.name: Unexpected Shadow
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: As Jade worked on her drawing, she noticed a shadow moving across her page - not the tree above her, but something larger and more defined. She looked up, expecting to see Noah.

lessons.name: Shadow Returns
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: He was several feet away, still absorbed in his experiment. The shadow passed over her again, this time slower, almost deliberate. It stretched across the grass before vanishing as quickly as it appeared.

lessons.name: Empty Field
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Jade scanned the area, her eyes darting from tree to tree, but there was no one in sight. She called Noah over with a wave, pointing to the spot where the shadow had disappeared. He squinted at the empty field, then at the trees swaying gently in the breeze.

lessons.name: Investigation Begins
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Noah was intrigued. The shadow hadn't been cast by any of the trees or the playground equipment. The two decided to investigate. Noah pulled out his pocket notebook and jotted down the details Jade described: the size of the shadow, its direction, and how it seemed to move independently of the trees.

lessons.name: Trick Light
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Jade scanned the area again, looking for anything unusual. The field was quiet, the trees tall and still. She noticed the light reflecting off the windows of the school building, casting faint patterns on the grass. Could the shadow have been a trick of the light? They walked toward the far edge of the field to see more.

lessons.name: Shadow Moves
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: As they moved closer to the tree line, a shadow appeared again. This time, it darted across the field.

lessons.name: Shifting Form
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: It stretched and shrunk in the fading sunlight. Jade and Noah froze, their eyes locked on the shifting form. It didn't move like a person or an animal.

lessons.name: Old Tree
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: It seemed almost fluid, like it was gliding over the ground. Noah quickly scribbled in his notebook, noting the direction the shadow had come from. He pointed toward the back of the playground, where an old oak tree stood.

lessons.name: Strange Patterns
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: The tree's gnarled roots stretched into the earth like a natural fortress. Beneath the tree's canopy, the light flickered in strange patterns, and Jade thought she saw movement. The two friends walked closer, spotting something unusual.

lessons.name: Etched Symbol
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: It was a series of shallow scratches etched into the bark. They looked deliberate, like someone had carved them recently. Jade ran her fingers over the grooves, noting how they curved and connected to form an odd spiral shape. It wasn't random; it looked like a symbol.

lessons.name: Disturbed Ground
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: Near the base of the tree, Noah noticed another clue. The snow around the roots had been disturbed, as if something had been digging there. He also found a smooth stone with a reflective surface. When he held it up to the sunlight, the light scattered into long, shifting beams across the ground.

lessons.name: Reflective Stones
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: The shadow, Jade thought. The strange movements they had seen earlier might have been caused by reflections from this stone, bouncing the light in unexpected ways. Noah noticed more reflective stones scattered in a circle around the base. Someone had deliberately placed them there to create a reflective pattern.

lessons.name: Mystery Box
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: The two noticed a small wooden box nestled among the tree roots, hidden beneath a layer of snow. Jade pulled it free, brushing off the frost. The box had a simple latch, and when she opened it, she found a folded piece of paper inside. Unfolding the paper, they saw a set of instructions written in neat handwriting.

lessons.name: Light Illusions
lessons.stage: The Mystery of the Shifting Shadow
lessons.text1: The note explained how to arrange the stones around the tree to create an optical illusion with the light. It ended with the line: "Welcome to my experiment! Keep the mystery alive!" The friends had fun that afternoon perfecting the arrangement of the stones, following the instructions in the note. They loved the mesmerizing display they created together!
